thicken_blocks: thicken a list of Minecraft blocks by expanding them by delta units in all directions
scale_blocks: scale a block structure up by specified factors along x, y, and z axes
scale_sparse_blocks: scale a sparse block structure up by specified factors along x, y, and z axes
shrink_blocks: shrink a block structure by sampling at reduced resolution along specified axes
rotate_blocks: rotate a list of blocks by a multiple of 90 degrees along a specified plane
replace_by_blocktype: replace blocks of a specific type with a new block type in the structure
replace_by_halfspace: replace blocks on one side of a geometric plane with a new block type
fill_flat: fill gaps between connected blocks along x, y, or z axes in a shape
hollow_blocks: hollow out a filled block structure keeping only boundary and air-touching blocks
moment_at_center: shift a block structure so its center of mass is centered in a given size array
